text:
Priya: incident-bot just paged billing-metrics: sudden token-count delta for eu1-emitter, +12% vs baseline in last 30m. Alerts on emit_rate and shadow_diff. :eyes:
incident-bot: Pager created: INCIDENT-2024-1897 - token_count_anomaly - severity:high. Links: https://ops.redwood/inci/INC-1897
Marco (oncall): on it. grabbing logs + checking emitter queue. @BillingOps can you confirm customer-facing overage emails?
BillingOps: we saw a handful of customers get auto-overage notices starting ~08:12 UTC. Support queue has 3 tickets so far. Not widespread but visible.
Jordan: can we get a quick query for emitted token totals by emitter for last 2 hours?
Marco (oncall): running quick SQL, will paste when done```
SELECT emitter_id, sum(tokens) as tokens_2h
FROM billing.emits
WHERE ts >= now() - interval '2 hours'
GROUP BY emitter_id
ORDER BY tokens_2h DESC
LIMIT 10;
```
Marco (oncall): results -> eu1-emitter shows +11.9% vs rolling baseline; shadow-emitter shows minor variance. Kafka consumer lag is normal. emitter-proxy 502 spikes around 08:08 but transient.
Priya: sounds like counting amplification rather than replay. Could be duplicate ack path from emitter shard swap. Any deploys around 08:00-08:10?
Jordan: deploys: infra-deploy at 07:58 for routing rule tweak (infra-team), then a small emitter restart at 08:05 to rotate credentials.
Marco (oncall): suspecting emitter restart triggered duplicate emit acknowledgements. Mitigation plan: 1) pause auto-overage emails (BillingOps) 2) add short dedupe window on emitter write path (hotfix toggle) 3) open emergency rollback of emitter restart if reproduceable.
BillingOps: pausing overage emails now (muted for 30m). customer_notify template held. Will proactively notify affected customers once we know scope.
Priya: Marco, can you flip the dedupe toggle and monitor counts? If it drops to baseline we can mark root cause and rollback the restart.
Marco (oncall): flipping toggle -> `curl -XPOST https://ops.redwood/feature/dedupe -d '{"emitter":"eu1","enable":true}'` -> 08:23:45 UTC - confirmed 200.
incident-bot: Alert summary update posted. Severity remains high until counts stable 15m.
Marco (oncall): after toggle, token delta trending down to +1.8% over 20m. Looks like dedupe mitigated duplication. No additional overage emails since mute.
Jordan: can we backfill corrected counts for invoicing window? Ops: we'll run a recon job to compute adjusted tokens and mark invoices tentative. Suggest a follow-up customer notification.
BillingOps: agreed — creating ticket to hold invoices and patch customer messages.
Priya: Next steps: 1) keep dedupe enabled for 3h 2) run full recon backfill job and validate against shadow ledger 3) postmortem with infra and emitter owners (assign to Marco + infra lead) 4) support to send targeted notice to impacted customers after recon.
Sam: I'm taking second-shift oncall at 09:00 UTC. Marco — can you hand off monitoring dashboards and the mitigation commands you ran?
Marco (oncall): handing off. Dashboards pinned in #incidents, runbook link: https://docs.redwood/ops/emitter-dedupe-runbook. Mitigation commands listed there.
Priya: thanks team. If counts re-spike, page SEV again. Otherwise we'll update this thread with recon results and a follow-up postmortem invite. :white_check_mark:
